email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

I am writing to apply for the Google Ads Media Buyer role at Growth Agency, as advertised on Jobgether. With hands-on Google Ads experience and a strong analytical mindset, I am eager to contribute to your DTC eCommerce clients' success.

In my current roles, I manage Google Ads campaigns and use data to optimize for profitability, not just vanity metrics. I have practical experience with Search, Display, Shopping, and Performance Max campaigns, and I regularly collaborate with feed management and tracking specialists to improve efficiency. My background in SEO and web development gives me a technical edge in conversion tracking and attribution.

I thrive in fast-paced environments where I can take ownership and make independent decisions. I am fluent in English and based in Belgium, within the EU time zone. I am excited about the opportunity to work with DTC brands and drive measurable business growth.

Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to discussing how I can contribute to your team.

Best regards,
Baver Ok

cover_letter:
Dear Hiring Team,

I am excited to apply for the Google Ads Media Buyer position at Growth Agency, as listed on Jobgether. With a solid foundation in digital marketing and a passion for performance-driven advertising, I am confident in my ability to manage and optimize Google Ads campaigns for DTC eCommerce brands, focusing on sustainable profitability.

In my current freelance and junior digital marketing roles, I have gained hands-on experience with Google Ads, managing campaigns across Search, Display, Shopping, and Performance Max. I have worked on optimizing shopping feeds, conducting creative and copy testing, and analyzing campaign performance beyond in-platform metrics to drive actual business results. My technical background in SEO and web development, including experience with Google Analytics and conversion tracking, allows me to implement and troubleshoot tracking setups effectively.

I thrive in environments that demand ownership and independent decision-making. At Episto, I handle on-page SEO and content for client websites, often taking initiative to identify opportunities for improvement. I am comfortable communicating with clients and stakeholders, and I welcome constructive feedback as a means to grow. My fluency in English and location in Belgium ensure I can collaborate seamlessly within EU time zones.

I am particularly drawn to this role because it emphasizes profit-focused strategies and continuous experimentation. I am eager to deepen my expertise in performance marketing and contribute to the growth of your clients' brands. I am confident that my analytical skills, technical curiosity, and growth mindset align well with the requirements of this position.

Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to the opportunity to discuss how I can add value to your team.

Sincerely,
Baver Ok
